faqs.q: What are Enhanced-Surface Tubes used for?
faqs.a: Tubes with a worked or coated surface that raises boiling or condensing performance: sintered porous-coated boiling tubes, helically twisted oval tubes and other enhanced profiles, for reboilers, evaporators and condensers.

faqs.q: What sizes can Enhanced-Surface Tubes be supplied in?
faqs.a: Enhanced-Surface Tubes can be supplied in the size you need (Sizes confirmed with the quotation). Tell us the size or capacity you need, and the application, through the enquiry and we confirm the dimensions and the part number with the quotation.

faqs.q: What tests and certificates come with Enhanced-Surface Tubes?
faqs.a: For Enhanced-Surface Tubes, mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 on request; third-party inspection by arrangement. Say on the enquiry which tests and inspection your project needs.

faqs.q: Which materials and grades are Enhanced-Surface Tubes available in?
faqs.a: Enhanced-Surface Tubes are available in these grades: CS; Stainless; Cu alloys; Ti. If your site needs a particular material grade, coating or material certificate, say so on the enquiry and we confirm it before the order.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to Enhanced-Surface Tubes?
faqs.a: Enhanced-Surface Tubes are made to ASTM A179, ASTM A192, ASTM A210, ASTM A213, ASTM B111, ASTM B338, ASTM B444, GB/T 20409-2006. Tell us the standard and grade on your enquiry; equivalent grades in other standards are indicative and are checked against each tender.

faqs.q: What do Enhanced-Surface Tubes connect to or fit with?
faqs.a: For Enhanced-Surface Tubes, tubes are rolled or welded into tube sheets or headers and carried on baffles or supports, so the outside diameter and wall must match the tube sheet drilling. Related ranges are the [HF-Welded Spiral Fin Tubes](/c/hf-welded-spiral-fin-tubes) and [Embedded G-Fin Tubes](/c/embedded-g-fin-tubes) shelves.

faqs.q: How should Enhanced-Surface Tubes be inspected on receipt and stored?
faqs.a: Check Enhanced-Surface Tubes on receipt against the order: outside diameter, wall, length, marking and the certificate heat numbers, and keep the ends capped until installation. Handle and store the material so the surface is not scratched or dented.
Enhanced-Surface Tubes are used for: Gas-plant reboilers and partial condensers, e.g. de-ethanisers in natural-gas processing.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to get a quotation for Enhanced-Surface Tubes?
faqs.a: For Enhanced-Surface Tubes, send the Indus part number from the size table, or the size and the load or duty you need, with the quantity and delivery country. Use [our contact page](/contact) and we reply with a price and lead time. Say on the RFQ if you need documents beyond the standard ones.

faqs.q: Can Enhanced-Surface Tubes be supplied to customers outside the UAE?
faqs.a: Yes. We supply Enhanced-Surface Tubes to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the delivery country and the drawing or data sheet through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.q: Where can I see other products like Enhanced-Surface Tubes?
faqs.a: Enhanced-Surface Tubes sit on our [Enhanced Surface Tubes shelf](/c/enhanced-surface-tubes), which lists the related patterns and sizes together, and related equipment is on the [HF-Welded Spiral Fin Tubes](/c/hf-welded-spiral-fin-tubes) shelf. If you cannot find what you need, send the specification through our contact page.

faqs.q: Is the Enhanced-Surface Tubes available from Indus Hydraulics in Dubai, and what is the lead time?
faqs.a: The Enhanced-Surface Tubes is built to order and supplied from Dubai, UAE, with shipping worldwide. The lead time is confirmed on the quotation. Send the size, rating and quantity through [our contact page](/contact) and we confirm the build and delivery date.
